notes.title: CaseOh vs Night Shift: A Slice of Horror
notes.content:
What happens when CaseOh clocks in for a shift at our pizza shop horror sim? Pure chaos. 

Confusion reigns in Night Shift, chairs mysteriously scattered around, and the atmosphere spirals into delicious madness. From haunted voices to unsettling surprises, it’s everything you'd expect it is not.

[hr][/hr]Here’s a short clip that captures the madness!
Timestamps: [25:00 - 25:20]
[previewyoutube=Z3fm1_sKwU8;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]A heartfelt thank you to indie.io for championing the indie game community and helping unique games find their audience. And a special shoutout to CaseOh, we loved seeing your hilarious and chaotic shift. You brought the night shift to life in the most unforgettable way! 🍕👻

notes.title: Five Horrors. Three Winners. One Unforgettable Nightmare.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491040/ec968aa48294c132e23f7d87414d6dfca4bd30b4.pngWe invite you to share this with your friends, help spread the fear… and make sure to wishlist these nightmares on Steam. Who will dare to enter the darkness?


Get ready for a spine-chilling horror fest! To celebrate our upcoming June 24 release, we're running a special giveaway from June 18 - June 24th. Three lucky winners will walk away with the complete set of five haunting horrors: Night Shift, Dark Mine, The Bunker, The Survivor, and Warning!
[hr][/hr]
Follow these easy steps to enter the chance to win a horror game bundle:


Step 1: 📩Share the horror with your friends.
Step 2: 🏆Enter the giveaway by clicking here.
Step 3: 🍀Increase your score by wishlisting the games.

[hr][/hr]
Contents:


Night Shift It’s just three nights. Just you, the pizza, and whatever that was in the corner of your eye. If you survive, you get paid.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602430/Night_Shift/

Warning  Monitor security cameras, report supernatural anomalies, and survive your night shift in a haunted underground ward.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602540/Warning/

Dark Mine Using only a handheld night vision camera in narrow tunnels, avoid the creature that stalks the dark and find your way to the surface.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602880/Dark_Mine/

The Bunker Alone in an abandoned, VHS-style bunker, uncover dark secrets and face psychological terror in an immersive found-footage horror journey.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487660/The_Bunker/

The Survivor Manage oxygen, power, and ship systems aboard a deteriorating spacecraft as unseen horrors stalk you in a tense sci‑fi survival thriller.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549320/The_Survivor/


🍀 Best of luck to everyone, we hope you enjoy diving into our games as much as we enjoyed creating them.

[hr][/hr] 
As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! If you find bugs or suggestions, feel free to share them in the community or join our 🎙️ Official Discord Server.

– Cyber752 Games

notes.title: Night Shift - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Calling Night Shifters!

We are thrilled to announce that Night Shift is launching on June 24th, 2025!

[previewyoutube=b8Glhb9zz4E;full][/previewyoutube]

You are working the night shift in a pizza store.

Feeling hungry? Our pizza will make you never hungry again. Apply today for the prestigious Night Shift at our beloved 24/7 pizza parlor. Clean up, clock in, survive.


🍕Hand out pizza to the night delivery crew.
🗑️Take out the trash before something else does.
🪑Put the chairs up on the tables. You’ll want a clear line of sight.


It’s just three nights. Just you, the pizza, and whatever that was in the corner of your eye. If you survive, you get paid. If you don’t… hey, you won’t be hungry anymore.
